Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță pentru externalizare și delocalizare
About Deutsche Telekom Services Europe Romania 
 In Romania, Deutsche Telekom has set up a Shared Service Center in Bucharest & Timisoara - Deutsche Telekom Services Europe Romania (DTSE Romania), which delivers support function services such as HR, Accounting, Reporting and Finance, as well as IT support services for these lines of business, for the whole European Deutsche Telekom footprint since July 2013. 
 We Are Focused On 
 the best customer experiences 
 delivering high quality services 
 great working conditions 
 growing with innovations 
 continuously improving competitiveness through digitalization 
 Key Responsabilities: 
Develop and maintain detection rules and use cases across SIEM, EDR, NDR, and cloud security platforms
Analyze emerging threats and translate them into actionable detection logic
Improve detection coverage based on threat intelligence, incident trends, and vulnerability exposure
Monitor security alerts and identify suspicious or malicious activity
Investigate anomalous events to determine real security threats
Collaborate with SOC analysts and incident responders to support effective investigations
Conduct penetration tests and security investigations; produce test reports and develop test automation tools
Design and perform safety investigations, analyze results, and propose solutions with customers when needed
Reduce false positives by tuning detection rules and correlation logic
Contribute to automation projects, building tools for test automation and attack reproducibility
Track and troubleshoot user issues, tasks, and incidents
Share industry and technical know-how across teams (knowledge transfer)
Participate in or manage sub-projects
Create, review, and maintain documentation, including publishing fixes to the central knowledge base
Work with global teams to ensure consistent processes and solutions
 Tools & Technologies: 
 SIEM 
Microsoft Sentinel
Splunk Enterprise Security
 EDR/XDR 
Microsoft Defender XDR
CrowdStrike Falcon
 Network & Infrastructure Detection 
NDR platforms
IDS/IPS
Firewall, proxy, VPN, and network telemetry solutions
 Cloud & Identity Security Monitoring 
Microsoft Entra / Azure AD logs
Microsoft 365 security telemetry
 Threat Intelligence & Detection Engineering 
Threat intelligence platforms and indicator feeds
MITRE ATT&CK mapping and detection use case libraries
IOC/IOA-based detection content
 Experience And Skills: 
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
5+ years of experience in data leakage analysis, cybersecurity monitoring, detection engineering, or SOC operations
Strong background in architecting, engineering, and automating security solutions for global environments, with a focus on Data Leakage Solutions
Proficiency in log analysis and event correlation
Hands-on experience developing detection rules
Advanced knowledge of security monitoring tools (SIEM, EDR/XDR, NDR)
Solid scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, or similar)
Knowledge of common attack techniques and tactics
Understanding of network protocols and system behavior
Familiarity with SIEM integrations
General knowledge of infrastructure (LDAP, Group Policy, Kerberos, Active Directory, etc.) and networking (routing, firewalls, OSI Model, packet trace and analysis, etc.)
